suggested_live_checks: Enter normal Scene Mode and HZoi idle: no tray at zero.
Enter an activity: blue/pink participant rings advance at declared independent rates; outfit/personality panels shift beside the tray.
Return to idle: progress decays, zero rows disappear and original panel arrangement returns.
Pause/unpause the game; change animation speed separately; verify the stated game-time rate behavior.
Resize/move the main panel with a configuration panel open; scroll the task tray independently.
Stay in rear long enough for completion/reset and another cycle; no completion media/consequences should run.
Exit/re-enter: progress resets, preferences/outfits still restore; normal movement remains available.
Optionally disable HZoi: framework hub remains usable without task declarations. Larger roster behavior has isolated coverage, not authored live group content.
